CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

2. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

5. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

7. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.

9. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

13. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rounders.

14. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   C. Damage equipment used for Football.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

15. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
